seed: The camera is a setting of the frame (decision card where-does-the-camera-live, option A), at Next defaults with no flag changed. On a recording with a title turned in 3D, View, Show Camera Settings picks the frame and the panel shows a Camera section: Perspective, Camera depth, Camera X and Camera Y, each with a key diamond. Typing 300 into Camera depth pushes the whole picture in; View, Reset Camera puts it back. The menu bar is only live with the app in front, so this walk takes the front.

steps.note: the frame picked by View, Show Camera Settings: the panel shows its Camera section, Perspective, Camera depth, Camera X and Camera Y, each with a key diamond. Camera depth 300 pushes the whole picture in, so everything is bigger about the middle
View, Reset Camera puts the camera back where every document starts: the picture is its own size again
